RVU HMI Program v75.0

Rift Valley University — Bishoftu Campus

🏫 About This Program

The RVU HMI Program is the digital management platform for Rift Valley University, Bishoftu Campus. It handles student grades, GPA reports, fee payments, attendance, and department workflows — all in one place, updated in real time across all devices.

🌐 Google Translate — Multilingual ☁️ Real-time cloud sync 💵 All amounts in ETB 📱 Works on any browser or phone
🔐 Roles & Access
Admin — Button 08
Full control of the program: upload data, manage all passwords, configure grade scale, and view all logs.
Registrar — Button 05
Open or close grade upload windows per department, review submissions, manage attendance, and update staff passwords.
Finance Head — Button 04
Set fee amounts and view the full payment ledger.
Cashier — Button 03
Search a student ID to record fee payments and approve payment requests.
Department Head — Button 07
Review grade submissions from teachers in your department, then approve or reject before sending to the Registrar.
Teacher — Button 06
Upload scores and grades for your department and semester once the Registrar has opened the upload window.
Student — Button 02
View your semester grades and GPA, and print an official GPA report using your Student ID — no password needed.
🎓 How Students Check Their Grades

Open Button 02 — Student Grade Portal and follow these steps:

1Enter your Student ID (e.g. 070/23) 2Select your Classification — Regular, Extension, Weekend, Distance, or Summer 3Select your Level — Diploma, Degree, Masters, or PhD 4Select your Department 5Select your Academic Year and Semester 6View your grades, credit hours, grade points, and cumulative GPA 7Tap Print Your GPA Results to get an official report with a verification code
📊 GPA Scale & Academic Status

A+ / A = 4.0  |  A− = 3.7  |  B+ = 3.5  |  B = 3.0  |  B− = 2.7  |  C+ = 2.5  |  C = 2.0  |  D = 1.0  |  F = 0

3.50 – 4.00EXCELLENT
3.00 – 3.49VERY GOOD
2.50 – 2.99GOOD
2.00 – 2.49SATISFACTORY
0.00 – 1.99FAIL

Score-to-grade boundaries are set by the Admin in the Grade Scale panel.

📤 How Grades Get Into the Program
1
Registrar opens the upload window for the relevant department (Button 05 → Dept Permissions).
2
Teacher uploads scores and grades for their department and semester (Button 06), then submits for review.
3
Department Head reviews the submission and either approves or rejects it (Button 07). Rejected submissions go back to the teacher.
4
Registrar commits the grades to the live program (Button 05 → Dept Data). Students can then view their results.

Every step is recorded in the Audit Log with the user's name and a timestamp.

⚠️ Important Notes
🔑 Keep your password or Student ID confidential — do not share it with anyone.
⏰ Grade uploads close automatically when the Registrar's deadline passes — submit on time.
🖨️ Printed GPA reports include a unique verification code that can be confirmed at the Registrar's Office.
🔄 The program updates in real time — if data changes, refresh the page to see the latest results.

📖 Program User Guide

Everything you need to use the RVU HMI Program — read top to bottom the first time.

⚡ Quick Start — 3 Things to Know
① Use the bottom bar to move between Home, Settings, Description, Rules, Exam Portal, and Exam Results.
② The top nav bar shows: All Program, Registration, Dept Head, Cashier Office and a ⋯ menu for Admin Panel, Finance Head, Teacher File, Exam Center, Payment Portal, Registrar.
③ Every panel requires a password except the Student Grade Portal (students use their Student ID) and All Program (open to all).
🧭 Navigation
🏠 Home — Returns to the main menu from anywhere.
⚙ Settings — Opens this user guide.
🖥️ Description — Overview and documentation of the program.
⚖️ Rules — Program terms of use and user rules.
📝 Exam Portal — Student exam entry. Opens only when the Exam Portal is unlocked by the Dept Head.
📊 Exam Results — Student result lookup. Opens only when the Results Portal is unlocked.
🏠 Who Uses Which Panel?
01
All Program
Browse course lists, grade tables, student lists, and credits. No password needed — just pick Year & Semester to view data.
02
Student Grade Portal
For students. Enter your Student ID, select Year & Semester, then tap View GPA Results to see your grades and GPA.
03
Cashier Office
For cashiers. Now on the main nav bar. Log in with the Cashier password, then search a Student ID to view and record fee payments.
04
Finance Head
For the Finance Head. Log in to review all payment records and financial reports.
05
Registrar's Office
For the Registrar or Admin. Manage department permissions, review submissions, track attendance, read audit logs, and update passwords.
06
Teacher Grade Upload
For teachers. Log in, select your department, choose the year & semester, upload your score and grade files, then submit to your department head.
07
Department Head
For department heads. Log in with your department password to review teacher submissions, then approve or reject and forward to the Registrar.
08
Admin Panel
For the program administrator. Now in the ⋯ dropdown menu. Full access: upload all data, manage all users, configure grades, view logs, and control all program settings.
👩‍🏫 Teachers — How to Submit Grades
1
Open Button 06 and enter the Teacher password.
2
Select your department from the dropdown. (Departments locked by the Registrar won't appear.)
3
Choose Classification, Level, Academic Year, and Semester.
4
Upload File A (numeric scores, 0–100) in .xlsx or .csv format. Letter grades are calculated automatically.
5
Check the preview table to confirm the data looks correct.
6
Tap Submit to Department. Your department head will review and forward to the Registrar.
📋 Registrar — What You Can Do
🏛️ Dept Permissions — Turn grade uploading on or off per department, and set submission deadlines.
📂 Dept Data — Review grade submissions waiting for your approval.
📅 Attendance — View and manage student attendance records.
📊 Audit Log — See a full timestamped history of every action in the program.
📨 Dept Messages — Read messages sent to you from departments.
🔑 My Password — Change your own Registrar password.
👩‍🏫 Teacher Password — Change the shared password used by all teachers.
📤 Admin — How to Upload Data
All data uploads are handled inside the Admin Panel (Button 08). Open the matching tab for what you want to upload:
👤 Students Tab
Upload the student list. Required columns:
student id  full name  classification  level  department  year  semester
📊 Grades Tab
Letter grades are calculated automatically from the uploaded numeric scores. No separate grade file upload is required.
📋 Scores Tab
Upload numeric scores per student per course. Required: student id + one column per course. Values must be 0 – 100.
🎓 Credits Tab
Upload course credit hours. Required: course credits. Credit values must be 2, 3, or 4 only.
📌 Upload New vs. Update Existing — What's the difference?
Upload New: Deletes all existing records for that section and replaces them with the file you upload. Use this for a fresh start.
Update Existing: Keeps current records and only changes rows that match. New rows in the file are added; nothing is deleted.
⚙ Grade Scale Settings (Admin only)
To change the score boundaries for each letter grade (A+, A, B+, etc.):
Open Button 08 → Admin Panel, then go to the Grade Scale section inside the dashboard.
📄 File Format Checklist — Before You Upload
✅ Use .xlsx, .xls, or .csv files only.
✅ The first row of your file must be column headers (exactly as listed above).
✅ Column names are not case-sensitive — Student ID and student id are treated the same.
✅ Scores must be numbers between 0 and 100.
✅ Grades must be one of: A+  A  B+  B  C+  C  D  F
✅ Credits must be 2, 3, or 4.
⚠️ Remove all blank rows and merged cells before uploading — they cause errors.

TERMS OF USE & USER RULES

RVU Relational HMI Program — v75.0

📋 1. Authorised Use & Role Access
  • This program is exclusively for registered students and authorised staff of Rift Valley University, Bishoftu Campus.
  • Access is role-gated by password: Admin, Registrar, Cashier, Finance Head, Dept Head, Teacher, Student (Student ID), Server Access. Using another person's credentials or attempting to access a role above your own is strictly prohibited.
  • All role passwords are stored as SHA-256 hashes in Firebase. Plain-text passwords are automatically migrated on first load. Never share your password verbally or in writing.
  • Unauthorised access may be subject to disciplinary or legal action under applicable Ethiopian law. Every login action is recorded in the Audit Log.
🔐 2. Role Responsibilities
  • Admin: Full program control — grade scale configuration, fee structure management, course credits, student data upload, all passwords, audit log access, database JSON export/backup, and academic calendar settings (years, semesters, curriculum).
  • Registrar: Manages department-level grade upload permissions and deadlines, attendance password, student registration permissions (new intake & re-registration), new/old student registration deadlines, and commits Dept Head-approved grades to the live database. Also manages messages and the permission matrix.
  • Finance Head: Reviews all payment ledger records, fee type configurations, and financial reports. No fee amount may be altered after a payment is approved.
  • Cashier: Searches students by ID, views fee clearance status, and records individual fee payments. Cannot alter fee type configurations.
  • Dept Head: Reviews teacher Score & Grade submissions for their department, approves or rejects uploads, manages the department exam bank, and sets per-department exam attendance thresholds. Must complete review within the Registrar's open window.
  • Teacher: Uploads Score File (A) for their assigned courses. Letter grades are calculated automatically by the system. Submitting falsified data is a serious academic integrity violation.
  • Student: Accesses the Student Grade Portal using their registered Student ID to view GPA results by academic year and semester, and to submit payment requests for their own fees only.
🎓 3. All Program — Data Viewing Rules
  • The All Program panel provides access to: Score (Course List), Student List, Grade Table, Credits, and the Student Grade Portal. Data is filtered by Academic Year → Semester → Class → Level → Department.
  • The Score tab displays uploaded course score data per class, level, and department. Only Admin can view all data without a role filter.
  • The Student List tab shows registered students. Admin can add course credits and edit academic configuration. Dept Head and Teacher views are filtered to their department.
  • The Grade tab shows committed grade data. Admin can view and print full tables. Dept Head and Teacher views are scoped to their department.
  • The Attendance tab is protected by a dedicated attendance password set by the Registrar. Attendance records are stored per course, class, level, department, year, and semester.
  • The Student Grade Portal allows any visitor to look up their own GPA results using only their Student ID. Printed GPA reports carry a unique verification code — they are not official documents unless physically stamped and signed by the Registrar.
🏛️ 4. Registration Rules
  • New student registration is only open when the Registrar has enabled it and the registration deadline has not passed. The program enforces this automatically. The Registration button is now on the main nav bar for quick access.
  • Old student re-registration requires payment clearance. Students blocked by the Cashier cannot complete re-registration until their fees are settled.
  • Each student may register only once per semester. Duplicate registrations within the same semester are rejected by the program.
  • Re-registration eligibility criteria (minimum GPA, maximum failed subjects, and class assignment) are configured by the Registrar and enforced automatically.
  • Students must not attempt to alter their own registration records. All self-editing is blocked — modifications must go through the Registrar's office.
  • The Database tab (Admin/Registrar only) provides an SQL-style viewer of all Firebase collections. No data may be exported, shared, or published beyond authorised technical personnel.
📝 5. Grade Upload & Exam Center Rules
  • Grade uploads are only accepted when the Registrar has explicitly granted permission for a department. Per-department deadlines are enforced automatically — late uploads are rejected.
  • Teachers must complete Score File (A) upload in a single submission cycle. Letter grades are derived automatically — partial uploads are not forwarded to the Dept Head for review.
  • Dept Heads must review and approve or reject teacher submissions within the open window. Delayed approvals causing grade unavailability are the Dept Head's responsibility.
  • The Exam Center is password-protected. The Dept Head manages the Exam Bank (question sets per course), opens/closes live exam sessions, sets the minimum attendance threshold required for a student to sit an exam, and controls the Exam Portal Lock (open/close student access to the Exam Portal, with optional auto-close deadline).
  • Students who do not meet the attendance threshold for a course are blocked from accessing that exam — this is enforced automatically by the program.
  • Exam results published through the Exam Center are visible to students via the Exam Results portal. The Dept Head controls whether results are open or closed for student viewing.
  • Uploading falsified, manipulated, or altered Score, Grade, or Exam files is a serious academic integrity violation and will be recorded in the Audit Log.
🖨️ 6. Printed Documents, Verification & Audit
  • All printed outputs (GPA reports, grade tables, attendance sheets, score lists) generated by this program carry the RVU seal, a date/time stamp, and a unique verification code. Altering or removing any of these elements is a forgery offence.
  • Verification codes on GPA printouts can be authenticated at the Registrar's Office. Printed reports are for personal reference only until physically stamped and signed by the Registrar.
  • No program output may be reproduced or submitted as an official document without the Registrar's written authorisation.
  • Every significant action in the program (logins, uploads, approvals, rejections, data changes, exports) is recorded in the Audit Log. The Audit Log is read-only for all roles including Admin — it cannot be deleted or altered.
  • The database JSON export/backup feature (Admin only) must not be distributed beyond authorised technical personnel. The export filename includes the program version for traceability.
🚫 7. Prohibited Actions
  • Do not attempt to reverse-engineer, decompile, modify, or tamper with the program's HTML, JavaScript, or Firebase security rules.
  • Do not upload falsified, altered, or manipulated Score, Grade, Student List, or Exam files.
  • Do not share, photograph, screenshot, publish, or distribute another student's academic, financial, or personal records.
  • Do not use the Database viewer, JSON export, or any admin tool for any purpose outside authorised academic administration.
  • Do not attempt to bypass the attendance threshold check to gain access to an exam session you are ineligible for.
  • Do not submit a payment request for another student's fees or attempt to manipulate the payment ledger or clearance status.
  • Do not attempt to alter or delete the Audit Log — it is permanently read-only for all roles.
⚠️ 8. Disclaimer & Liability
  • This program runs entirely in the browser and syncs data live with Firebase Firestore. A stable internet connection is required for all data operations — uploads, saves, and real-time sync.
  • RVU and the program developer accept no liability for data loss resulting from browser clearing, device failure, or network interruption during an active upload or save session.
  • Data displayed in this program is for informational purposes. Always verify critical academic, financial, or registration decisions with the Registrar's Office directly.
  • For grade disputes or correction requests, contact your department instructor or the Registrar's Office — do not attempt to alter records yourself.
  • Program availability is subject to Firebase service uptime. Planned maintenance windows will be communicated by the Registrar's Office in advance.
  • The Google Translate feature is provided for accessibility only. The English content is the authoritative version of all program text, rules, and instructions.
By using this program you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to all rules above.
